settings.text: Pink sapphires are a beautiful variety of the corundum mineral family, admired for their enchanting range of colors from pale pink pastels to vivid magenta tones. The unique pink color in these sapphires is caused by the presence of trace elements such as chromium. With their exceptional hardness, second only to diamonds, pink sapphires are not only stunning but also durable, making them perfect for everyday wear.

Our pink sapphire bracelets at Shamballa Jewels are designed to highlight the gemstone’s natural charm. Each bracelet features carefully selected pink sapphires that showcase their captivating color, from soft blush tones to vibrant pinks. These pieces are ideal for adding a touch of romance and sophistication to any outfit, whether you’re dressing for a casual day out or a special occasion. With their timeless beauty and strength, pink sapphire bracelets offer a lasting addition to any jewelry collection.

Pink sapphires are formed deep within the Earth under high pressure and temperature conditions. The presence of chromium during the formation process gives pink sapphires their distinctive color. Sourced from reputable mines around the world, our pink sapphires are selected for their quality and vibrant hue, ensuring each piece is of the highest standard.
